nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3 OrbitQuant
widgets_values:
MINIMAX H3 — ORBITQUANT W4A4

This workflow follows ComfyUI's bundled
MiniMax H3 Text to Video preset.

Layout:
- model and usage notes on the left
- compact generation in the center
- core Save Video on the right

Official preset:
Comfy-Org/workflow_templates
video_minimax_h3_t2v.json

KEY INPUTS

prompt
Describe the shot, camera motion, dialogue,
sound effects, and music in one block.

task
t2va for text-to-video. Use ref2va plus a
local reference_path for reference-to-video.

inference_profile
balanced is the safe default; speed keeps the
transformer resident; minimum_vram streams
weights with low-CPU-memory loading.

width / height
Verified at 608 × 480.

num_frames
124 frames: the shortest verified
five-second H3 packing sequence.

steps
24 sigma points / 23 denoiser forwards.

OFFLOAD AND PRECISION

The text encoder executes sequentially on GPU
for conditioning and returns to CPU afterward.
Ref2VA reference encoding uses tiled sequential
GPU VAE execution. Visual and audio decode use
untouched source FP32 VAEs.

nodes.title: Generate Video (Verified 608 × 480)
widgets_values: Create one uninterrupted five-second photorealistic cinematic shot inside a vast abandoned Victorian astronomical conservatory during a midnight thunderstorm. Begin centimetres above a flooded mosaic floor on an extreme macro view of a scratched silver compass as a raindrop creates concentric ripples through reflected amber lamps. In the background, the same young female astronomer with dark hazel eyes, a small scar through her right eyebrow, rain-darkened curls and a burgundy wool coat runs toward an antique brass orrery. The camera performs one fast but smooth backward-and-upward crane with a clockwise half-orbit, passes cleanly between rotating copper rings, racks focus from the compass to her face, then transitions into a controlled push-in. Preserve strong physical parallax, straight architecture, attached compass parts, stable orrery topology, readable glass planets, plausible splashes, coherent wet fabric, fixed facial identity, aligned eyes, natural lips, five stable fingers and consistent hairline throughout every frame. A blue-white lightning flash crosses the dome and illuminates the woman, water, brass and glass coherently, followed by physically delayed thunder. In the final close-up she catches her breath, looks into the lens, grips a small brass lever and says clearly in Russian: «Не бойся грома — смотри, как небо запоминает нас». Synchronize her lips and preserve a single natural voice. Build continuous stereo sound from rain, footsteps, brass gears, wind through cracked glass, lightning and thunder; no electronic squeal, duplicated speech or clipping. Use believable anamorphic photography, restrained halation, realistic skin, natural motion blur, coherent reflections and subtle sensor grain. No cuts, temporal resets, face morphing, crossed eyes, melting mouth, texture crawling, checkerboard grids, duplicated limbs, subtitles, logos, watermarks or black frames.

nodes.title: Note: Verified Profile
widgets_values:
VERIFIED 480P PROFILE

width                 608
height                480
frames                124
fps                    24
sigma points           24
denoiser forwards      23
default profile  balanced
visual VAE     source FP32
audio VAE      source FP32

H3 accepts 5–15 seconds. The runner rejects
shorter frame counts before allocating the
denoiser, preventing expensive invalid jobs.

Scheduler checkpoints, the latent bundle,
metrics, and stage logs are persisted as soon
as each artifact exists.
